messages:
Olivia Chen: Hey team — ran into this while testing function-calling on a fine-tuned model. Backend returns a raw error: `ModelMismatchError: function not found` and the UI surfaces that exact message. No guidance for users.
Samir Patel: I hit this too. Happens when the request names a function the model doesn't expose. Right now we just bubble up the exception string from the runtime.
Jordan: Oof. Bad UX. We should give an actionable message + one-click next steps.
Olivia Chen: Agreed. Proposal: concise title + 1 line of help + a CTA to view supported functions. Maybe a link to docs as a secondary action.
Samir Patel: Implementation wise I can return an error type `function_not_supported` with a payload of supported functions; UI can render a toast with an expandable detail.
Jordan: Draft microcopy: "Selected model doesn't support this function." Detail: "This model doesn't include the requested function. View the functions this model supports or switch to a compatible model." CTA: "View supported functions" (opens modal).
Olivia Chen: Love the direction. Two accessibility points: 1) info/CTA needs an aria-label that includes the model name, 2) expandable details must be keyboard-focusable.
Samir Patel: Good call. I'll make sure the button has `aria-label="View supported functions for <model-name>"` and the modal traps focus. Also adding a small telemetry event `function_error_suggested_action`.
Jordan: Tiny wording tweak: replace "switch to a compatible model" with "try a compatible model" — softer. Also include a short CLI hint in the details so power users can quickly inspect supported functions, e.g.:
```
# list functions for a model
redwood models describe <model-name>
```
Olivia Chen: Perfect. For localization keys: `errors.function_not_supported.title`, `errors.function_not_supported.body`, `errors.function_not_supported.cta_view_functions`, `errors.function_not_supported.cta_switch_model`.
design-bot: Accessibility lint: ensure link text isn't "learn more" alone — use descriptive text; check focus order on toast -> modal.
Samir Patel: Will do. Draft final copy I'll ship in PR: 
Title: "Selected model doesn't support this function."
Body: "This model doesn't include the requested function. View supported functions or try a compatible model."
Primary CTA: "View supported functions" (aria-label: "View supported functions for <model-name>")
Secondary CTA (link): "Try a compatible model"
CLI hint in expandable details: `redwood models describe <model-name>`
Jordan: LGTM from design. Make sure the modal lists functions and allows keyboard copy of function signatures.
Olivia Chen: Approved. Once PR lands I'll update the copy tokens in the translations repo.
Samir Patel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1234 — includes API error type + UI changes.
Olivia Chen: Thanks everyone :tada:
